nodes.text: Welcome, welcome. No names needed. I find they clutter a sale. Everything on this counter has a history and none of it is written down. That's the service.
Buying, selling, or practicing your questions? The first two are quicker.

choices.text: Where do your goods come from?
Aren't you worried about the watch?

nodes.text: From *around*. Caravans lighten themselves on the High Road, the Undercroft coughs up curiosities, estates get settled faster than the heirs expected. I ask no questions coming in, so I can honestly answer none going out. If provenance matters to you, Vigdis is up the walk, and she charges for all that paper.

The watch doesn't come past the scree, per an arrangement above both our stations. And understand: Mab has rules stricter than any magistrate. Nothing from city homes, nothing from the shrine, nothing that got anyone hurt on this mountain. Break those and you don't answer to the watch. You answer to *her*.
The counter, then. Keys of uncertain doors, leather of flexible biography, and sundries. Coin only. Smile optional.
A pleasure doing nothing memorable with you.
